title: ReviewerSummary
description: Reviewer summary for the human merge gate. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

severity.description: Overall merge-risk level. Use high for correctness, security, migration, data-loss, or failed-verification concerns that should block merge.

issues.description: Short human-readable summary of concrete issues for the merge gate. Empty list when there are no meaningful issues.

recommendation.description: approve only when verification passed and no blocking concerns remain. request_changes when the PR needs a Fixer/rebuild/human follow-up before merge.

findings.description: Optional structured findings suitable for later inline PR comments. Omit or leave empty when there are no concrete findings.

path.description: Repository-relative file path for the finding. Use an empty string only for a whole-PR finding with no specific file.

line.description: Optional 1-based start line when the finding maps to a specific line.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based end line for a multi-line finding.
